## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a069bdb668fd1e49f78e3fa9a4d0e3ea58c3fe25`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` run read-only in a throwaway `git worktree` under the scratchpad at the head and at `origin/main` (badf24df), to confirm the 6116 → 6122 / 6123 numbers the PR body and os-dev-report 6672202451 claim; worktree removed afterwards, checked-out tree untouched. Nothing built, no GitHub write.
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, .changeset/30466-extension-plurallabel-exception.md + packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (origin/main L905–922, L5499–5512), packages/objectql/src/registry-extension-plural-label.test.ts, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (L272, L511–513), docs/adr/0029-kernel-object-ownership-and-platform-objects-decomposition.md (L470–473), AGENTS.md (L270–278, L1019–1024), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, /mnt/project-files/skills-lane-seat1/dispatch-30466.md, card #30466 (body, triage 6658700520, claim 6671830258, os-dev-report 6672202451), PR #30722 body and file list, PR #30459 body, file list and contract record 6658126879.

Diff read as `git diff origin/main...FETCH_HEAD` (merge-base badf24df): two files, +13/−2, matching the PR file list (`.changeset/30466-extension-plurallabel-exception.md` added, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` +3/−2). No `docs/adr/**` or `packages/**` path in the diff (the order's ⛔ surfaces hold).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Rule location and condition — right.** `origin/main` `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` L909–918: `yields(key)` is `tenantAuthored?.has(key) === true` (L909); the outer branch is `extension.label !== undefined && !yields('label')` (L910); inside it, L916 `if (extension.pluralLabel === undefined && extension.label !== merged.label && !yields('pluralLabel')) { delete merged.pluralLabel; }` then `merged.label = extension.label` (L919). So the four parts of the sentence map one to one: "a new `label`" = the extension's label differs from the **running** `merged.label` (not the packaged owner's label; an earlier extender's label counts), "without `pluralLabel`" = `extension.pluralLabel === undefined`, "clears" = `delete` of the key, "unless a tenant authored it" = `!yields('pluralLabel')`.
- **"Clears" is the precise verb.** The key is deleted from the fold's output, not replaced by a derived plural: `registry-extension-plural-label.test.ts` L51–55 pins `pluralLabel: undefined, hasPluralLabel: false` on `getObject`, and L57–63 pins that `getPackagedObjectBase` keeps `Tasks`. What `/meta/object` then serves is the spec's "object with no `pluralLabel`" shape, with the owner pair's own translation of the plural allowed in (PR #30459 body, record 6658126879 ① change 2); that is not the base's plural, so "clears the base plural" neither over- nor under-states the served result.
- **"unless a tenant authored it" — right, and complete.** `tenantAuthoredScalars` (registry.ts L5499–5512) marks a scalar as authored when the `own` contributor's body diverges from the fold's base for that key, i.e. an overlay/tenant layer wrote it. Test L100–105 pins a tenant `To-dos` surviving a rename. The second way the plural survives, a tenant-authored `label` (outer `!yields('label')` L910; test L107–112), is covered by the sentence's premise: with the label yielding there is no applied "new `label`". "it" reads naturally as the plural; both survival cases are inside the sentence's truth set.
- **"(set both)" is the correct remedy.** registry.ts L920–922 writes `extension.pluralLabel` when set; test L68–72 pins label + plural served as set, and L120–124 pins a later plural landing over an earlier rename. Setting `pluralLabel` beside `label` is the only author-side way to keep a plural on the renamed object (PR #30459 changeset remedy, record 6658126879 ②).
- **Generality nuance, no fix owed.** The deleted plural is the running one, so a lower-priority extender's plural is also taken off by a higher-priority rename (test L114–118). The sentence says "the base plural"; in the section's frame ("an object you do not own", SKILL.md head L345) the base is the extended object, and an author who sets both is safe either way. Prose only.
- **Not a rule drop: the deleted link.** On `origin/main` `references/data-hooks.md` is linked at SKILL.md L46 (catalog list), L160 (backfill paragraph) and L340 (parenthetical on the Lifecycle Hooks pointer). At the head L46 and L160 are unchanged and L340 keeps its pointer to `references/examples-objects.md` § Lifecycle Hooks; only the parenthetical restating the hooks-reference link is gone. No reader loses the only pointer, and no rule, ⛔ or ❗ text moved.
- **Accept-set and public surface: unchanged — right.** `packages/spec` is untouched; nothing an author can write changes. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` re-derived from the diff: correct.
- **Ratchet numbers — reproduced.** Ceiling row `['skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md', 6123]` at `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` L513, untouched by the diff. Probe: `origin/main` measures 6116 (headroom 7), the head measures 6122 (headroom 1), exit 0 both times. The dev's claim holds.
- **Out of scope honoured.** ADR-0029 L472–473 still reads "merges fields additively ... and has no expression for *removal* at all"; not edited, quoted in the PR body and os-dev-report for the seat to raise for Tier H, as the order asked.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/30466-extension-plurallabel-exception.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in the body. AGENTS.md L1019–1021: a change in a released package takes a `patch` changeset, never none and never `skip-changeset`. Level matches a docs-only change to the shipped skill. PR labels carry no `skip-changeset`; `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
- PR body carries `Fixes #30466`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, each line-initial and identical to the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Deviation: ratchet payment by deleting the L340 parenthetical link, outside the pinned sentence** — answered in ① (duplicate at L46 and L160 on the head; pointer to `examples-objects.md` § Lifecycle Hooks kept; no rule text). The pin "no other skill text changes" cannot hold at 7 tokens of headroom with a +12-token sentence; the dev declared it and chose the smallest same-file deletion. Accepted.
2. **Deviation: the sentence also names the tenant-authored yield** — right; without it the sentence would over-state (a tenant `To-dos` is not cleared, test L100–105). Accepted.
3. **Relay `pr_create` HTTP 500 twice, third landed #30722** — procedural; head and file list confirm one PR. No finding.
4. **Assign/request-review skipped per standing lines** — procedural; no finding.
5. **`open_questions`: none.** Out-of-scope finding (ADR-0029 D9.2 L473) carried by the seat for Tier H; not a finding of this diff.
6. **PR author** — `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no non-bot login to name. The body's attribution comment records the requester as `os-elon-musk`.
7. **Served-tier** — `skills/**` is a Tier H governed surface (AGENTS.md L273–276); governed rule text hit ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, as asked. PR is `draft: true`, `auto_merge: null`; landing is the maintainer's hand.
8. **Check-runs on the head** at 2026-11-05T23:31Z: every completed run is `success` or `skipped` (Auto Label, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped lints, PR-body guards, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, filter). Still `in_progress`: Build Core, Lint · CI/release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Live E2E UI, Test Core (1/8) and (2/8), Type Check · consumer gates / debt ledger / source gates / workspace. No run is red. A red among the pending runs reopens this record.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (governed rule text).** The one-sentence change keeps "an extension can add but never remove" as the rule and names exactly the exception the fold has on `main`, in the fold's own terms (new label, no plural, tenant yield, remedy). Checked against the acceptance scenario: a reader who renames an object and reads this sentence knows the plural goes and knows to set both; a reader who adds fields, or sets only `pluralLabel`, or repeats the label, is still inside "never remove" (tests L74–98). Nothing in the sentence promises more than L916 does, and nothing L916 does is left unsaid except the running-vs-base nuance above. The ⛔ `ownership` warning and the schema pointer that follow are intact. The sentence runs long on one line (L350), consistent with the file's existing long-line style (L340, L92).

**`.changeset/30466-extension-plurallabel-exception.md`.** Summary line matches the diff; the body restates the rule correctly, including "an extension that repeats the label it extends removes nothing" (test L94–98) and the link-deletion rationale; "No schema, key or behaviour changes" is true.

Trying to break the sentence: an extension on an object whose base has no plural — the delete is a no-op, the sentence's "clears" is vacuous but not false. A `.custom` pair extension — the fold is one `mergeObjectDefinitions` for every `extend` contributor (record 6658126879 ①), so the sentence holds for pairs too. Two extenders — covered by the "running" nuance, no author-visible contradiction.

No must-fix. No should-fix.

- 需要你做的:① 批准并合并(`skills/**` 为 Tier H)。契约复核 PASS 评论 6672290914,Head-sha `a069bdb668fd1e49f78e3fa9a4d0e3ea58c3fe25`。② 你来定:ADR-0029 D9.2(`docs/adr/0029-kernel-object-ownership-and-platform-objects-decomposition.md` L472–473)说 `mergeObjectDefinitions` “has no expression for *removal* at all”,对 `pluralLabel` 已不精确,是加一条修订注,还是保持原样。本 PR 不碰 ADR。
- 席位意见:可合。ADR 席位建议加一行修订注(不改决策),由你定。
